blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–George King admitted that there was plenty to be desired with the way he’s been playing in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals. But keen on atoning for his struggles and urged on by teammates and an unlikely source, King’s 35 points played a crucial role in San Miguel Beer’s 108-102 win on Friday that forced their series with Barangay Ginebra to a decider. “My shots didn’t feel good the first two games, three games, even missing free throws so I’m dealing with some mechanical things,” King said. “I’m not putting the ball in […]...
